statement: We leave several open problems. Our algorithm offers an exponential (in n) improvement (2−ϵ)n over a naive algorithm for domains D of constant size. Can we hope for an O(|D| e · polylog(M )) time algorithm for f -Convolution for some ϵ > 0? We are not aware of any n lower bounds, so in principle even an O(|D|e · polylog(M )) time algorithm is plausible. n
context: The cyclic partition is a very general tool and potentially it can be used to achieve greater improvements for certain functions f . For example, in multiple applications (e.g., [20, 34, 24, 29]) the function f has a cyclic partition with a single cyclic minor. Nevertheless, in our proof we only use cyclic minors where one dimension is at most 2. We suspect that better results can be obtained by considering larger minors. We leave several open problems.
